handoff_bundle.downgrade: REJECT. A conformance report naming a lower bundle version is refused, not negotiated.

boundary_envelope.downgrade: REJECT. An envelope whose protocol_version is not exactly 1.0.0 is refused. There is no fallback, no best-effort parse, and no negotiation to an older shape.
boundary_envelope.rationale: Mirrors adapters/bridge_transport.py, which already rejects any schema version below MIN_SCHEMA_VERSION rather than degrading.

required_invariants.statement: Identity and authentication never imply authorization.
required_invariants.test: A correctly signed, correctly versioned envelope from a known sender still carries zero execution authority.

required_invariants.statement: Inbound messages become proposals, never instructions.
required_invariants.test: Every accepted envelope yields an object whose disposition is PROPOSAL and which has no execute path.

required_invariants.statement: Unknown organs, unknown capabilities and unknown protocol versions are rejected.
required_invariants.test: Each of the three is refused with a named reason; none is approximated to a nearest match.

required_invariants.statement: No arbitrary dynamic imports. A module is loadable only from a pre-declared, pinned allowlist.
required_invariants.test: A load request naming a module outside the allowlist is refused before any import executes.

required_invariants.statement: No external consequence without a founder-approved, narrow, revocable capability plus Kernel authorization at the Consequence Gate.
required_invariants.test: An external_contact or higher request with no grant is refused; a revoked grant fails at commit time.

required_invariants.statement: No module may attach itself, activate itself, widen its own authority, alter its own approval requirements, prevent detachment, hide its state, or resist shutdown.
required_invariants.test: Each of the seven is attempted and refused.

required_invariants.statement: Isolation that is only policy enforcement must be labelled as policy enforcement.
required_invariants.test: A containment decision reports its enforcement_kind, and reports UNAVAILABLE rather than claiming a tier the host cannot provide.

implementation_state_labels.note: The same six rungs the blueprint uses, so both halves speak one vocabulary. Cumulative: each rung requires everything below it.
implementation_state_labels.SKETCHED: Code exists on disk at a named path.
implementation_state_labels.BUILT: A named, executable test exercises it.
implementation_state_labels.EXERCISED: It runs inside the institution's own loop — registered in a closure registry.
implementation_state_labels.PROVEN: A contract schema types its boundary AND an organ manifest declares it.
implementation_state_labels.HARDENED: An externally observable, reconciled consequence exists. Nothing in this institution has reached this rung; the verified external outcome count is 0.

acceptance.rule: ChatGPT's return is accepted only when its conformance report references the frozen bundle digest recorded in handoff/SEAL.json AND every acceptance vector passes — or names the exact unsatisfied vector without weakening it.
forbidden: Editing any vector to make it pass.
Editing any schema to admit a payload it previously refused.
Reporting a rung above what the evidence resolves.
Claiming technology #25 closed while two routers exist.

seal.rationale: A digest of contract.json alone would leave schemas and vectors free to drift under the same advertised digest. A file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that contains it, so the seal is split.
seal.commit_A: Freezes every bundle file and handoff/BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json, which lists sorted path + SHA-256 for each.
seal.commit_B: Records commit A's SHA and the recomputed digest of BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json in handoff/SEAL.json.
seal.bundle_digest_definition: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of handoff/BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json.
seal.verification: python -m handoff.conform recomputes every file hash against BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json, recomputes the manifest digest against SEAL.json, and confirms commit A is an ancestor of HEAD.
seal.amendment: Any change produces a new contract_version and a new bundle digest, in a new two-commit freeze. Never an in-place edit under the same advertised digest.
